hypothesis.definition_origin: Tleilax X post, user-supplied ECMWF seasonal map, official ECMWF/Copernicus documentation and ICE Dutch TTF contract specification
hypothesis.source_claim: A hot European winter is expected and should create a tradeable opportunity in winter Dutch TTF futures.
hypothesis.decision_information: Use only a verified public August ECMWF SEAS5 release and machine-readable ensemble or tercile-probability fields available at the decision timestamp. Do not infer a numeric trigger from screenshot colors and do not use the embedded Polymarket El Nino claim.
hypothesis.target_instrument: Equal-weight ICE Endex Dutch TTF December, January and February monthly futures for the forecast winter
hypothesis.benchmark: Matched August five-session returns for the same DJF strip construction, controlled by release year and broad supply regime
applicable_regimes: absence of a dominant simultaneous physical-supply shock
invalid_regimes: storage or regulatory intervention dominating weather
hypothesis.deactivation_rule: Reject or redesign if point-in-time forecast reconstruction fails, if ten independent events do not show a negative after-cost five-session TTF response versus the frozen benchmark, or if apparent performance is explained by one supply regime.
hypothesis.timezone: ECMWF release timestamps in UTC; ICE entry and exit use official exchange settlement dates and Central European exchange time
hypothesis.bar_size: ECMWF seasonal issuance and daily ICE settlements
blocking_fields: Retrieve and archive the machine-readable August 2026 ECMWF SEAS5 field needed to calculate the fixed-region upper-tercile probability.
Acquire point-in-time historical ICE Endex Dutch TTF December, January and February settlement history with contract identifiers and rolls.
Construct at least ten independent August forecast-release events without lookahead or survivorship bias.
hypothesis.source_fidelity_notes: The map supports a broad warm-European-winter interpretation but not a precise regional probability. The screenshot's separate Polymarket Super El Nino statement is not part of this source claim or trigger.
hypothesis.trigger_rule: For the August-initialized ECMWF SEAS5 forecast, calculate the area-weighted probability that DJF mean 2m temperature lies in the model-specific upper tercile over 35N-60N and 10W-30E. Trigger only when the probability is at least 60 percent.
hypothesis.entry_rule: Enter a short research position at the next official ICE settlement after the verified public release timestamp, using an equal-weight strip of the December, January and February monthly TTF contracts.
hypothesis.exit_rule: Primary exit is the official settlement after five ICE trading sessions. Twenty-session and November 30 exits are diagnostics and cannot replace the primary result after outcomes are observed.
hypothesis.direction_rule: Short the equal-weight DJF TTF strip only; no long or options variant belongs to the canonical test.
hypothesis.cost_model: Subtract EUR 0.05/MWh round trip from the strip return, covering at least two minimum ticks plus a conservative allowance for commission and slippage.
hypothesis.out_of_sample_boundary: 2026-08-05 source capture. The first untouched canonical observation begins only after the verified public August 2026 release and machine-readable regional calculation; the screenshot alone cannot start a canonical trade.
